verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official `bentolabs` CLI. It has dedicated installation, overview, commands and resource docs, and claims dashboard parity from the terminal, scripts or CI. Supporting details include browser-based auth that stores tokens in the keychain, raw JSON output to stdout for piping into tools like jq, and signal list/read/update commands. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as documented.
